verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a team-chat platform, but the evidence pack never documents a way to act on many messages, topics, or channels at once. The material covers search filters, single-message API calls, bots and whole-organization export or import. Those are adjacent building blocks or migration tools, not a bulk-operations capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
